review_notes: I read the whole file (the long import list and the Cyclic and Main sections) and looked for nontrivial reasoning repeated across proofs. The two lemmas that both reason about a cyclic 3-group are mem_of_le_of_ne_bot and mem_centralizer_of_coprime. They already share the helpers zpowers_eq_of_orderOf, mul_comm_of_isCyclic and mem_of_le_of_ne_bot, so the main argument is factored out. The repeated `have : Fact (Nat.Prime 3) := ⟨Nat.prime_three⟩` is a one-line instance setup and too trivial to count under the rubric. In normalizer_le_centralizer_or_exists_inv, the derivations of hao and hbo are two short orderOf_pow_of_dvd calculations, which the rubric excludes as short calculations. Using `exists_prime_orderOf_dvd_card'` to get an element of prime order is a common pattern across the repo (Assembly/Reduction.lean, GroupActions/SelfCentralizingCoreOuterPrimeBound.lean and others). Those uses are one-line API calls and not shared proof machinery. A repo-wide grep turned up no near-duplicate of the cyclic or normalizer argument in this file. I did not exhaustively diff other files. I found no justified finding.
